rule: Structural-home role keying and token carriage
description: `plugin/governance/remediation-doctrine.md` `## Defer-with-Scope` is the single source for the keying of "structural home" as a ROLE rather than a destination TYPE. The source pin is ONE span carrying BOTH halves of that rule — the role definition (the term names a role, not a destination type; the tail's reasoning has a durable home; the admissible destinations are enumerated ONCE in that section and restated nowhere else) and the obligation that definition triggers (a restatement naming a destination type re-narrows the role to one destination and is FORBIDDEN). Both halves are pinned together because either one alone leaves the other rewritable: a definition-only pin stays green while the prohibition is deleted, and a prohibition-only pin stays green while the role is re-keyed back to a destination type. The consumers pin the TOKEN only, never remedy prose, so honest rewording of the doctrine body does not break them: `plugin/skills/detect-remediation-signals/SKILL.md` must still emit `structural-home` as a member of the `advisory_reason` enum, `plugin/agents/github-reviewer.md` must still carry that same enum on its `merge-advised` output contract, `plugin/agents/overlord.md` must still render the role-named `structural home: <structural_home>` field in the merge advisory it surfaces to the user, and `plugin/skills/github-review-loop/SKILL.md` must still transport `structural_home` alongside `advisory_reason` and `recommendation_text`. Those four tokens are the end-to-end carriage of the role-keyed value from detector to user; dropping it from any one file is loud. What this pin honestly guarantees is exactly that these word sequences exist in these five named files; it claims nothing about meaning. Residuals, stated plainly: (1) a prose re-narrowing that leaves the pinned bytes intact is invisible — surrounding text that reintroduces a destination-type restatement elsewhere, or that treats the carried value as a tracker entry while the pinned sentence stands, stays green; (2) the destination-type EXAMPLES sit inside the pinned span because a single span must be contiguous to carry both halves, so rewording or extending those examples turns the suite red even when the rule itself is unchanged — an accepted cost of pinning the definition and the prohibition together; (3) the sentence tail carrying the remedy (restate the role bare and cite this section) is deliberately OUTSIDE the span so the remedy stays cheap to reword honestly, and deleting that tail alone stays green; (4) the pin sees only the five files it names — a further consumer that drops its token is invisible, and no fixture in this directory can detect a NEW consumer authored without the token at all, which is an absence defect per rule 7 of the pin-authoring contract.

source.pattern: "Structural home" names a ROLE, not a destination type: the tail's reasoning has a durable home. The admissible destinations are enumerated ONCE — here — and no other section, agent, or skill restates them. A restatement that names a destination type ("a tracked structural home", "an issue") re-narrows the role to one destination and is forbidden
